title: Obugulumivu Obubbira
intro: Kuba akafaananyi ku kino: emmeeme ayambadde engoye ennungi era nga yeetooloddwa eby’obugagga ebitayinza kulowooza. Ono ssekinnoomu yali alowooza nti obugagga bwe bwafunibwa okuyita mu magezi ge, nga takkirizangako nsibuko ya bintu bya mazima. Ng’atambula mu bagoberezi ba nnabbi ow’amaanyi, omuntu ono yagaana buli kuyitibwa okw’obwetoowaze. Leero, tubikkula ekika ky’omuntu omugagga gwe ogw’ekitalo gwe gwafuuka ekifo kyabwe ekisembayo we baawummulira.
clues: Nabeerawo mu kiseera kya nnabbi eyayita eggwanga ery’obukakanyavu mu mazima.
Nnali kitundu kya kitundu ekyalondebwa, naye omutima gwange gwava ku bubaka obwo.
Zaabu ne ffeeza byankwata okusinga ekiragiro kyonna eky’obwakatonda.
Ebifo byange eby’obugagga byakula nnyo ne kiba nti ekibinja ky’abasajja ab’amaanyi baali basobola bulungi kusitula bisumuluzo.
Nneewaana nti obugagga bwange bwampeebwa olw’okumanya kwange.
Ku nkomerero, nze n’ekifo kyange kyonna mwe nnabeera twamira ensi ng’okulabula.

arabic: فَخَرَجَ عَلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ فِى زِينَتِهِۦ ۖ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يُرِيدُونَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا يَـٰلَيْتَ لَنَا مِثْلَ مَآ أُوتِىَ قَـٰرُونُ إِنَّهُۥ لَذُو حَظٍّ عَظِيمٍۢ
verse: So he came out before his people in his adornment. Those who desired the worldly life said, "Oh, would that we had like what was given to Qārūn. Indeed, he is one of great fortune." (28:79)
